clone.name: E3/workbench_clone_as_source_owner
command:
set -eu
work=/home/USER/ysyx-workbench
test ! -e "$work"
git -c core.autocrlf=false clone --no-hardlinks /workspace/YSYX_F_B_Archive/repos/OSCPU__ysyx-workbench "$work"
test "$(realpath "$work")" = /home/USER/ysyx-workbench
